messages:
Maya (Finance): Quick alarm for month-close: reconciliation shows ~48,200 discrepancy in deferred revenue tied to promo credits. A few committed accounts and trial cohort affected. @Omar @Kai can you triage? :warning:
Omar (Billing): digging in. billing run `monthly/invoice-run/2024-04` retried last night and I see duplicate promo credits for the 'trial-pricing-experiment' tag. looks like duplicates were created on retry, idempotency missing.
Lina (RevOps): can you paste the export lines so we can mark customers in the close pack? need to know which are deferrable vs realized revenue reductions.
Omar (Billing): export snippet:
```
invoice_id,account_id,charge_type,amount,note
INV-80121,acct_110,credit,-1500,"promo:trial-pricing-experiment"
INV-80121,acct_110,credit,-1500,"promo:trial-pricing-experiment"
INV-80122,acct_111,credit,-600,"promo:trial-pricing-experiment"
```
Omar (Billing): looks like retry path omitted idempotency_key when experiment flag toggled. billing-job report: duplicates=34 total_dup_amount=48200 (billing-bot).
billing-bot: invoice-run alert: retried=1 duplicates=34 total_dup_amount=48200
Kai (SRE Billing): confirmed root cause. consumer retry wrapper doesn't attach idempotency for `promo_apply` when feature flag on. PR to ensure idempotency_key enforced for promo_apply.
Raj (Accounting): implications for close: if these credits reduced billed revenue, we need to adjust revenue recognition. propose temporary accrual JE if backfill won't complete before COB. Lina, are these credits recorded post-recognition or netted?
Lina (RevOps): majority are post-invoice credits for trials and reduce recognized revenue. For committed customers where revenue was already recognized, we treat as contra-revenue (move back into deferred or issue reversing JE). I've updated the close pack mapping.
Elise (SalesOps): note — a few customers already received credit memos. we should avoid reissuing or confusing CX. coordinate timeline with us before any mass re-billing.
Maya (Finance): action plan:
- Omar/Kai: patch to prevent further dups + backfill CSV with rows to delete (by EOD)
- Omar: dry-run backfill in staging and produce before/after exports
- Lina: mark each account as "deferrable" or "credit_memo_issued" in close pack
- Raj: prepare accrual JE template if needed (GL mapping 4001 -> 2300)
- Elise: prepare customer comms for the small set who saw visible credits

Omar (Billing): uploading /shared/finance/billing_fix_1718600000.csv with primary_key, invoice_id, orig_line_id, dup_line_id. running staging dry-run now.
Kai (SRE Billing): patch merged and rolling out. ran idempotency scan across SQS consumers in staging. scheduling prod backfill at 02:00 UTC to avoid overlap with next invoice window.
Raj (Accounting): draft JE: "Dr Sales Revenue 48,200; Cr Deferred Revenue 48,200" — recommend posting as accrual if backfill not finished pre-close, reverse on completion. tagging @Maya for approval.
Maya (Finance): approve accrual approach for close. include memo: 'duplicate promo credit application from billing retry; reversing recognized revenue to deferred to preserve close integrity.'
Lina (RevOps): uploaded customer-level impact sheet to the close pack; flagged six customers who have visible credits and need SalesOps coordination.
Elise (SalesOps): will prepare one-liner for customers and coordinate with support to avoid duplicate outreach.
Omar (Billing): backfill dry-run successful in staging. production backfill scheduled; expect 4-6 hour turnaround including verification. will post verification script and before/after exports.
Kai (SRE Billing): post-deploy checks look good. added telemetry to catch duplicate promo applies in future.
Raj (Accounting): if backfill completes before COB we'll adjust rev schedules and reverse the accrual; otherwise we'll post the accrual and reverse next month.
Maya (Finance): thanks everyone. update the month-close tracker and ping when the final CSV is ready for accounting. target: close pack updated by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
